sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach's recent form shows a solitary loss in their last five outings, but they remain in commanding position. Alsager Town arrive in poor form and occupy the bottom half of the table, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be expected to consolidate their position at the summit.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place with 20 points, travel to Dawley Town on Saturday and will be looking to keep pace with leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two sides in contrasting recent form—Bridgnorth have won four of their last five while Eccleshall are rebuilding after a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth, welcome Wednesfield Community to a local derby fixture, with Casuals on a strong run of three consecutive wins. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton travel to face Shawbury United—the latter enduring a concerning six-game losing streak. Widnes Town, bottom of the table, visit Brereton Social, who themselves have recent struggles to overcome. Telford Town travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in a basement-six clash, Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a battle of mid-table sides, and Crewe welcome Allscott Heath. A midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Wednesfield Community visit Brereton Social at 19:45.
